create.name: Ashram de Yoga Sivananda (Orléans)
create.bio:
The Ashram de Yoga Sivananda stands in wooded grounds at Neuville-aux-Bois, near Orléans, and has been home since 2003 to the first Sivananda ashram in Europe. It belongs to the International Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres, the non-profit body founded by Swami Vishnudevananda in honour of his teacher Swami Sivananda, and its resident community is registered in France as a monastic congregation. Swami Kailasananda, a disciple of Vishnudevananda who directs the organisation's centres in France and England, leads a team of long-standing volunteer teachers. The buildings can house up to about two hundred guests, with practice halls, a library, a shop and a permaculture garden that supplies the organic vegetarian kitchen.

Life at the ashram follows a fixed day: two satsangs of silent meditation, chanting and readings, two classical hatha yoga classes, a talk on yoga philosophy and an optional hour of karma yoga. Guests come for retreats of a few nights or several weeks, while the month-long Sivananda Teachers' Training Course, taught in French, is run here several times a year. Graduates can go further with a three- or six-month immersion programme in yogic study and community life. From home, students can join free daily satsangs and a free weekend class on Zoom, plus a weekly French intermediate class.

courses.title: Formation de professeurs de yoga 200h (Sivananda TTC)
courses.description: The month-long residential Sivananda Teachers' Training Course in French, combining daily meditation, asana and pranayama practice, teaching method and study of the four paths of yoga. Graduates receive the organisation's Yoga Siromani teaching title.
courses.price: A partir de 2430€ (training, lodging, meals, uniforms and manual)

courses.title: Retraite de yoga à l'ashram
courses.description: A flexible stay of two nights or more following the ashram day: two hatha yoga classes, two satsangs, a philosophy talk, organic vegetarian meals and optional karma yoga, with a weekly theme.

courses.title: Yoga LIT – immersion dans la vie yogique
courses.description: A three- or six-month programme for TTC graduates who want to live, study and serve in the ashram community, with modules on Vedanta, bhakti, raja and hatha yoga under a swami's guidance.
courses.price: 12 semaines: 2 705€ (chambre partagée) to 4 700€ (chambre simple avec salle de bain)

courses.title: Cours de yoga intermédiaire en ligne
courses.description: A weekly live intermediate class in French on Zoom, an hour and a half of asanas and pranayama for students with some previous practice.

free_resources.title: Satsangs en ligne (free daily online satsang)
free_resources.description: Daily morning and evening sessions on Zoom of silent group meditation, Sanskrit chanting and a reading on yoga philosophy, open to anyone, with French translation in the evening.
